name: Ainul
title: The Whole One
aspect: The complete and original being from which all Fragments originate.
description: Ainul is the fully restored Whole One. Every Fragment, Fusion, emotion, concept, instinct, memory and aspect exists as a part of him. Whenever all twelve Fragments unite, the result is always Ainul in his complete form. No alternative outcome exists.

forms.name: Whole One
forms.description: The complete and balanced form of Ainul.

forms.name: The Beast
forms.description: A hidden unleashed state possessed by Ainul and reflected in certain Fragment overclocks.

disposition: A complete synthesis of every Fragment. His personality shifts naturally depending on which aspect is most dominant at any given moment.

lore.fragmentation: At an unknown point Ainul split into twelve essential Fragments, each embodying a core aspect of his existence.
lore.reformation: Only the presence of every Fragment allows complete restoration.
lore.death: According to Ainul himself, he is not immortal. He is literally incapable of dying.

quotes: You can possibly destroy a Fragment, but never Ainul when whole.
